metaDescription: Shopify store for Kross Kulture, a women's pret label: named collection drops, a four-item menu, size guides, discount badges and PKR or other currencies.
summary: Shopify store for a Pakistani women's pret and luxury pret label.
overview: Kross Kulture sells women's pret and luxury pret, from embroidered one-, two- and three-piece outfits to trousers and girls' sizes, across a catalog of more than 200 products. We built Kross Kulture's Shopify store on the Kalles theme, with a short menu, named collection drops and product pages that spell out exactly what comes in each outfit.
challenge: The range is released as named drops such as Ghazal, Mushq and Rozmara, while shoppers also look by type: pret, luxury pret or sale. Much of the catalog carries a markdown at any given time, and the store serves customers both in Pakistan and abroad.
approach: The header keeps a large search bar and a four-item menu: Sale, KK Studio, Luxury Pret and Pret. The homepage leads with the current drop and a shop-by-category grid. Collection pages show discount badges with a filter and sort, and product pages show the original and sale price, SKU, an international shipping note, size buttons with a size guide and a full breakdown of shirt, trouser and dupatta fabrics.
outcome: A Shopify store where shoppers can go straight from the latest drop to a product, see the discount, pick a size against the guide and check out in PKR or their own currency, on desktop or phone.

process.title: Menu and search
process.body: A four-item menu (Sale, KK Studio, Luxury Pret, Pret) sits under a wide search bar, so shoppers either browse a line or search a design name directly.

process.title: Collection drops
process.body: Each named drop gets its own banner and collection page, with a filter, sort options and percentage-off badges on the product cards.

process.title: Product detail
process.body: Product pages show the sale and original price, SKU, size buttons with a size guide link, and a description listing package contents, fabrics, color and the model's size and height.

process.title: Local and international
process.body: A currency selector and announcement bar cover both local free-shipping and flat-rate international shipping, so overseas shoppers see the terms before they add to cart.

whyItMatters: Fashion labels that release in named drops need a store that puts the newest collection first without hiding the rest. Clear fabric details and a size guide on every product page answer the questions that otherwise slow down an order.

faqs.q: What platform is the Kross Kulture store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Kalles theme, using Shopify collections for each drop, a currency selector and a size guide on product pages.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We build Shopify stores for fashion labels, including collection drops, sale merchandising and product pages with size guides. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
